adjudication.rationale: The diff shows that refreshOAuthTokens() returns the response directly when APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED is true (line 7-14 of refreshOAuthTokens.ts returns the fetch response). However, in CalendarService.ts for Lark, the code passes this response to handleLarkError<RefreshTokenResp>(resp, this.log) which expects a Lark-specific envelope format with nested data structure. When credential sync is enabled, the response format from the sync endpoint would be different (just access_token and expiry as documented), causing handleLarkError to fail or return incorrect data when it tries to access data.data properties.
